summary: Iteration 5 backend+frontend testing for the split create-only + multi-packet jangad flow. Updated TestBulkProcessPackets to match new API contract (no karigar/hw/ds/exp on create; response is {created:[packet,...], count, total_weight}; packets in_stock, no entries created). Added new TestJangads class covering POST /api/jangads (single shared jangad_no for N packets, HW/DS/exp per-process routing, double-issue rejection, bad-input handling) and GET /api/jangads/{jangad_no} (lines[], totals, kapan_no per line). All 36 backend tests pass; 1 test intentionally xfails and pinpoints a real (minor) backend bug: dashboard.open_jangads counts entry rows instead of unique jangad_no. UI: Add-Packets dialog is create-only (no karigar/hw/ds/exp fields, auto-size works, submit posts to process-packets, packets appear in stock table). Issue dialog on /issue shows select-all + multi-row packet table + live selection summary + process-specific batch fields (laser -> HW+ExpRetPcs shown, DS hidden; polish -> DS shown, HW hidden; sarine/nats -> none). Submitting a batch of 3 packets produces exactly one shared jangad_no (verified via GET /api/kapans/{id}). /jangad/{jangadNo} renders a single slip with all lines, total row, and one signature block. Mobile 390px: dialog usable, submit reachable.

minor.issue: open_jangads counts entry rows, not unique jangad_no. With a 2-packet jangad, open_jangads increases by 2 instead of 1. Fix: replace `sum(1 for e in entries if not e.get('returned'))` at server.py:844 with `len({e['jangad_no'] for e in entries if not e.get('returned') and e.get('jangad_no')})`. Marked as xfail in TestJangads::test_dashboard_open_jangads_counts_unique so suite stays green until fixed.

issues: Dialog + underlying page content render together in the screenshot suggesting a partially-transparent overlay; content is functional and submit button is reachable but labels appear cramped. Consider `bg-white` (opaque) on DialogContent and reducing sm:grid-cols density on <640px.

action_items: Fix dashboard.open_jangads to count unique jangad_no instead of entry rows (server.py line 844).
Optional: opaque background for Issue dialog on mobile to prevent visual bleed-through from the underlying stats bar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 909 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting into routers/{auth,kapans,packets,jangads,entries,dashboard}.py.

In POST /api/jangads (create_jangad) at server.py:544, next_jangad_no() is called BEFORE writing entries but AFTER validation. Under concurrent issues the counter is only incremented once per call which is fine, but the entire flow is not wrapped in a Mongo transaction — a mid-loop failure would leave the packets table with mixed status (some issued, some in_stock) and orphan entries. Consider a session/transaction or an idempotency guard.

create_jangad accepts hw/ds/expected_return_pcs from payload but only applies them when process matches — good — but there's no validation that they are non-empty when process IS laser/polish. UI probably enforces it; add server-side minimal validation for consistency.
get_jangad_by_no at server.py:596 loads ALL kapans (to_list(2000)) just to resolve kapan_no for each line. Prefer a $lookup or a targeted find({_id: {$in: kapan_ids}}) once entries are loaded.

PROCESSES list is duplicated implicitly across the codebase; PROCESS_LABELS is source of truth — good. But models.py has no enum on process fields, so any string bypasses validation until the handler check.
Frontend Packets.jsx line 196 correctly uses `new Set(...).size` for the page-level Jangads stat; keep this pattern and align the dashboard backend to it (see minor bug above).

success_rate.backend: 100% (36/36 passed, 1 xfailed on a documented minor bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the flows exercised (add-packets create-only, multi-select issue, one-jangad-per-batch, per-process field routing, jangad slip, mobile)

One xfail intentionally documents the dashboard.open_jangads=entries bug — when fixed, flip the xfail to a strict assert delta == 1 and drop the xfail block.

Minor: dashboard.open_jangads uses entry-row count rather than distinct jangad_no set; reproduce by GET /api/dashboard before/after POST /api/jangads with 2+ packet_ids; expected delta 1, actual delta = number of packets. Fix in server.py line 844 as noted above.
